description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/day), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/day_/), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000058481), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4419005879)

On his first school day since being discharged from the military, Eun-tae barely escapes late with a bus ticket dropped by someone. Eun-tae, who fell in love with a girl at a glance at a classroom, succeeded in finding out her name when checking attendance, but the owner of the name... [Gdai] Choi Yong-sung's romance work!
